_comment: Virtual test config for launch/virtual_tracking.launch.py, read by apriltag_detection, apriltag_control and virtual_tracking_sim. The sim ground truth uses each calibration point (z_ref, x_ref, yaw_ref; detach has only z_ref) like apriltag_control, so any calibrated values work; the factory x_ref 0.026 equals the sim camera_y_offset, giving goals on the tag centre line. Copy this file and pass config_file:= for variant tests (control.dock_timeout 3.0 -> TIMEOUT); TAG_LOST: launch argument hide_tag_after:=5.0.

_doc.s4_distances: S4 (m): equivalent-distance breakpoints for a tag of ref_tag_size; beyond the last one the yaw is not used
_doc.s4_sigmas_deg: S4 (deg): yaw precision at each breakpoint; larger = the yaw filter trusts the measurement less
_doc.border_px: S1 (px, >= 0): a tag corner closer than this to the image edge sets c_quality = 0 (yaw not trusted for that frame)
_doc.margin_lo: S1 (>= 0, < margin_hi): decision_margin at or below this gives c_quality 0
_doc.margin_hi: S1: decision_margin at or above this gives c_quality 1 (linear between margin_lo and margin_hi)
_doc.sigma_dh: S2 (px, > 0): noise of dh (left edge - right edge height) with camera and tag still; SNR = |dh| / sigma_dh. Larger = needs a bigger dh before the yaw sign is trusted
_doc.snr_lo: S2 (>= 0, < snr_hi): SNR at or below this gives c_sign 0 (yaw sign unknown, yaw used as 0)
_doc.snr_hi: S2: SNR at or above this gives c_sign 1 (yaw sign trusted; linear between snr_lo and snr_hi)
_doc.ref_tag_size: S4 (m, > 0): tag size the s4 table was measured with (not the tag in use); change only when the table is recalibrated
_doc.q_proc: S5 (rad^2/s, >= 0): yaw filter process noise. Larger = yaw_f follows new measurements faster but noisier; smaller = smoother but lags
_doc.gate_sigma: S5 (> 0): outlier gate = max(gate_sigma * sigma, gate_min_deg); a measurement farther than this from yaw_f is rejected
_doc.accept_frames: S5 (int >= 1): after this many consecutive rejected frames that agree within consistency_deg, yaw_f jumps to their mean (anti-stuck). Larger = fewer, later jumps
_doc.consistency_deg: S5 (deg, > 0): how close the rejected frames must be to each other to be accepted as the new yaw
_doc.abs_window: frames (int >= 1) in the |yaw_meas| median (yaw_abs_f) used by the in-position check and the S3 probe
_doc.xy_tau: x / y EMA time constant (s, >= 0; 0 = no filtering)

_doc.trigger_frames: int >= 1: the probe starts after this many consecutive frames with c_sign < c_sign_low (Stage 1, x / y within stage1_tolerance)
_doc.c_sign_low: (0, 1]: c_sign below this counts as 'yaw direction unknown'
_doc.trigger_yaw: rad, > 0: the probe starts only if yaw_abs_f (|yaw| median) is above this
_doc.wz: rad/s, > 0: turn speed while probing; replaces the LQR wz
_doc.turn_time: s, > 0: duration of one probe turn
_doc.settle_frames: int >= 1: still frames after a turn before |yaw| is compared
_doc.end_yaw_deg: deg, > 0: the probe ends when yaw_abs_f is below this
_doc.change_deg: deg, >= 0: |yaw| change after a turn that counts as better (same way) or worse (reverse)
_doc.end_c_sign: (0, 1]: the probe ends and hands back to the LQR when c_sign reaches this (direction known)
_doc.initial_direction: 1 or -1: direction of the first probe turn (+wz / -wz)
_doc.max_turns: int >= 1: the probe ends after this many turns
